fields.name: magic
fields.evidence: Both .sav files start 34 31 30 30 41 42 47 45; FUN_0803ade8 loops iVar3 0..7 comparing read bytes to _DAT_0803ae30 and returns 2 on mismatch.

fields.name: global_settings_byte_a
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cd7c: *(global+8) = *(settings+0x2A); FUN_0802cd48 inverse. Observed file byte 0x08 changed 0x0C->0x0B between samples; traced writer cannot be proven to have produced this change (byte 0x0B contradiction).

fields.name: global_settings_byte_b
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cd7c: *(global+9) = *(settings+0x2B); FUN_080371b8 branches adjust byte at settings+0x2B via func_0x0802d094/func_0x0802d0c4 with +/-1.

fields.name: global_settings_byte_c
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cd7c: *(global+10) = *(settings+0x2D); FUN_0803a978: *(mgr+10) = FUN_08040f68(); FUN_080371b8 writes settings+0x2D = item-0x42 before calling FUN_0802cd7c.

fields.name: global_initialized_marker
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cd7c: *(global+0xB) = 1; FUN_0803a978: *(mgr+0xB) = 1. File bytes 0x0A and 0x0B are both 0x00 in both samples under either byte-order hypothesis.

fields.name: global_settings_bitfield_u16
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cd7c masked-merge lines and *(byte*)(global+0xD) = &0x7F | settings[0x2C]<<7; FUN_0802cd48: *(u16*)(settings+0x2E) = *(u16*)(global+0xC) & 0x7FFF. Role static-confirmed; observed-change attribution is hypothesis. Empirically verified via headless mGBA boundary fuzzing (save rejection boundary: unsigned-range [1, 65535]).

fields.name: global_checksum
fields.evidence: Python verification on both samples: sum of eight BE u16 words = 0x0000, stored BE word 0x070A == -sum(first seven BE words) 0x070A. LE on file bytes fails (sum 0x00FF). Code: FUN_0803ada4 mgr[7]=-sum; FUN_0803a8b0 zeroes +0xE, stamps -FUN_0803ad80(mgr,0x10).

fields.name: slot0_header
fields.evidence: FUN_0803a91c loop FUN_08008fe8(0x10+slot*0xAA0, 0x10, zeroed buffer); FUN_0803ac9c calls FUN_0802cfdc(mgr+0x14+slot*0x10) after loading each slot.

fields.name: slot1_header
fields.evidence: Same FUN_0803a91c/FUN_0803ac9c code paths with slot index 1; file range 0xAB0..0xABF is 16 zero bytes in both samples.

fields.name: slot2_header
fields.evidence: Same code paths with slot index 2; file range 0x1550..0x155F is 16 zero bytes in both samples.

fields.name: slot_payload
fields.evidence: No function calls FUN_08008fe8 with length 0xAA0 and no field reader beyond the header copy exists in decompiled.c; samples contain only 0xFF here, so no field subdivision is derivable.

fields.name: slot_checksum_candidate
fields.evidence: FUN_0803acf8: *(bool*)(mgr+0x44+slot) = (FUN_0803ad80(slot_buffer, 0xAA0) == 0). Both samples sum to 0xFAB8 per slot (invalid/empty), consistent with never-written 0xFF payload.

fields.name: tail_unused
fields.evidence: Geometry derived from FUN_0803ad28 offset formula (0x10 + slot*0xAA0, size 0xAA0) exhausts the file except these 16 bytes; full-corpus constant search found no accessor.
